name: Eris
tagline: The Discordia — the dwarf planet whose discovery demoted Pluto.

facts.label: Surface
facts.value: Nitrogen and methane ice — among the brightest known

history: Eris was discovered in 2005 as a Pluto-sized world on a wildly inclined, eccentric orbit — so massive it forced the IAU to write the dwarf-planet definition in 2006, demoting both Pluto and itself from planet status. Named for the goddess of discord, it sparked the exact controversy its name implies. Its surface is blindingly reflective nitrogen-methane ice — at aphelion its atmosphere freezes and falls as snow. A moon, Dysnomia (lawlessness), completes the mythology.
